descriptions.job-16b3bgy:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most. 

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading large cross-functional programs linked to our Products. This role reports to the Head of TPM within Ripple Core. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future customer needs. You will bring a strong understanding of traditional finance and trading markets, and use it to help bridge the needs of financial institutions with the capabilities of digital asset infrastructure. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to design robust and scalable systems, lead product schedules, remove roadblocks, and ensure high development velocity. Ideal candidates have a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end and providing technical leadership to deliver for customers. You will shape program strategy and execution within your area, while knowing when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver customer-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Own the strategy, planning, and execution of one or more complex, cross-functional programs across our product initiatives by understanding our customers, markets, and technology deeply.
  • Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.
  • Communicate with purpose and clarity to stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, bringing together cross-functional teams to achieve program objectives.

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in sophisticated enterprise technology environments, working directly with many teams across functions.
  • Experience managing programs in traditional finance (TradFi), such as banking, asset management, broker-dealers, custodians, or financial market infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the financial services landscape.
  • Experience with and understanding of trading markets (crypto or traditional), including the trade lifecycle (order management, execution, clearing, and settlement), market structure, and liquidity.
  • Ability to use data and analytics to look at trends and lead the health of projects and systems.
  • Shown understanding and working knowledge of software development and modern project management standard processes, such as Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma, etc.
  • Ability to coordinate multi-functionally, build consensus, and deliver across teams. Able to influence without authority, negotiate, and encourage others in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience with project planning tools such as Jira and Confluence, and proficiency in Google Sheets.
  • Experience crafting or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Define Integration Architecture: Establish scalable, reusable integration patterns and interface designs across our enterprise software ecosystem, balancing performance, maintainability, security, and delivery speed
  • Build Mission-Critical Integrations: Develop and support real-time APIs, event-driven workflows, and scheduled data pipelines connecting third-party platforms (Zip, SAP Concur, etc,.) directly with core ERP systems.
  • Modernize Core Connectivity: Bridge legacy Oracle EBS data structures with modern cloud APIs, designing reliable data orchestration using native OIC adapters, REST/SOAP services, and custom PL/SQL packages.
    Engineer Resilient Data Flows: Implement defensive engineering practices across all data interfaces, incorporating OAuth authentication, webhooks, rate limiting, pagination, idempotency, automated retries, and failure recovery.
  • Future-Proof Systems: Prepare the enterprise integration layer for our upcoming full ERP revamp and future integration with manufacturing/supply chain systems (MES/WMS).
    Own Production Reliability: Monitor integration health, establish automated alerting, lead incident response, and resolve data discrepancies, API timeouts, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Embed Enterprise Governance: Incorporate role-based access controls, transaction audit trails, payload validations, and segregation of duties into integration design to satisfy internal controls and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders—including procurement leads, FP&A teams, and ERP specialists across the US and Singapore to turn business needs into production-grade interfaces.

How you will stand out:

  • Bring Senior Integration Experience: Have 6–10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise integration development, system architecture, and interface design, with a demonstrated record of operating high-availability production workflows.
  • Possess Deep OIC Expertise: Bring deep, production-tested proficiency with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC Gen 2 / Gen 3), including custom recipe design, advanced mapping (XSLT/XPath), and lifecycle management.
  • Understand Core Financial & Operational Processes: Understand the end-to-end business workflows behind Record-to-Report(R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), expense management, and financial planning & consolidation.
  • Master Modern API Standards: Have built and maintained complex third-party API integrations with deep knowledge of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, SFTP, and modern authentication frameworks (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • Demonstrate Database & Scripting Strength: Are proficient in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for complex queries and stored procedures, with experience leveraging scripting languages (such as Python or Shell) for custom integration services, automated tests, or operational tooling.
  • Prioritize System Reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of systems throughout their production lifecycle, emphasize operational readiness, and approach troubleshooting with structured root-cause analysis.
  • Navigate Ambiguity Independently: Are an autonomous individual contributor who communicates technical issues and business trade-offs clearly to both engineering peers and business leadership across multiple time zones.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

In this role, you’d be joining the Big Data Infrastructure team. Our team builds and maintains the platforms that power data work across Stripe, managing three core layers:

  • Data Orchestration (Airflow)
  • Batch Compute (Spark, Celeborn)
  • Data Lake (Iceberg, Hive, S3, Azure Blob Storage)

We support over 2,000 engineers and 600+ internal teams, processing workloads that organically grow more than 30% year over year. Our infrastructure handles massive scale, managing over 800 PB of data, running 325,000 applications a day, and accounting for hundreds of millions of dollars in annual spend, directly powering critical pipelines like inbound payments, network reconciliation, and capital underwriting.

What you’ll do

As the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, you will guide a 40+ person engineering team to scale our foundational data systems. You will partner closely with major internal customers like Data Foundations, Payins Engineering, and AI/ML Foundations to modernize our tech stack and execute Stripe's transition to the "Agentic Era" - building "invisible infrastructure" where AI agents operate data pipelines end-to-end. 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, overseeing distributed systems that manage 20% of Stripe's total AWS spend
  • Execute Stripe's transition to the "Agentic Era" by building invisible infrastructure that empowers AI agents to author, validate, ship, and operate data pipelines
  • Drive the architecture and delivery of critical modernization bets, including YARN to Kubernetes migrations, native vectorization (Gluten/Velox), and Airflow and Data Catalog modernization
  • Lead the implementation of a multi-region and multi-cloud data strategy for high availability, disaster recovery, and Azure Blob Storage compliance
  • Reduce operational burden and maintenance overhead (KTLO) from over 40% to under 10% by shifting fixes into the platform instead of relying on runbooks
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence and mentor engineers at various stages in their careers, up to Staff+

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
  • This is a Senior Staff role, so ideally 12+ years of professional experience in a software development role
  • A strong engineering background in distributed infrastructure and/or platform services, including one or more of the following: storage, databases, or compute
  • Experience leading projects on a cross-team and company-wide scale, including scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging distributed systems while optimizing their reliability and security
  • Experience driving a culture of operational excellence, with a deep understanding of metrics, alerts, and dashboards

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience driving AI-led architectural transformations and integrating agentic workflows into large-scale data systems
  • Experience in a development team at AWS, Azure, OCI, or Google
  • Experience with big data infrastructure at scale, such as Spark, Iceberg, S3, Airflow, YARN, and Celeborn
  • Experience with database internals and/or with Kubernetes

We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You’ll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You’ll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You’ll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you’ve turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You’ll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

You Will

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

  • Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
  • Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
  • Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
  • Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.

  • 5+ years of experience in customer operations, customer experience, or support leadership, ideally within fintech, crypto, or financial services.

Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning.

This setting breaks nearly every assumption of datacenter training: communication-efficient training across different parallelism axes, fault tolerance as nodes join and drop mid-run, heterogeneous compute and networks, and robustness to malicious participants. Our published methods include Subspace Networks, Factored Gossip DiLoCo, AsyncMesh, and Sentinel.

As a Research Scientist you'll build the training system that takes Protocol Learning from the 8B run to frontier scale: large models on heterogeneous hardware, in physically different regions, connected by ordinary internet.

Key Responsibilities

  • Distributed pretraining: Implement and optimize model-parallel training. Data, pipeline, and tensor parallelism for large models on heterogeneous GPUs under low-bandwidth, high-latency links.

  • Performance optimization: Implement techniques that reduce communication overhead while maintaining model convergence in challenging network environments.

  • Elasticity and fault tolerance: Make runs survive node churn. Robust checkpointing, state synchronization, and recovery as participants join and leave.

About the team

Every Circle product depends on this team to answer two questions: who is making a request, and what should they be allowed to do?

We build the platform behind customer identity and access for Circle Hub, Circle Mint, Custody, the Cross-Chain Payments Network, and the Developer Console. Our systems handle sign-up and sign-in, sessions and API credentials, service-to-service authentication, enterprise SSO, organizations and workspaces, user and role management, and the Policy Engine that governs approvals and access for money movement across products.


The next chapter is extending those capabilities to AI agents. Agents will need identities of their own, carefully bounded authority, short-lived credentials, and audit trails that connect every action back to the person or organization responsible for it.

This is a product and platform engineering team—not an IT access-administration function. The systems we build sit at the intersection of customer experience, security, reliability, and financial risk.


The role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering manager who has built identity or authorization systems at scale and can lead a team through significant platform change. You will set the technical direction for authentication, authorization, customer and emerging agent identity capabilities. You will manage and grow a team, partner closely with Security and product teams, and stay close to the work through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, incident response, and occasional implementation with a strong AI focus. This is both a people-management and technical role. You will be expected to make architecture decisions, explain trade-offs clearly, and create the conditions for the team to execute well. You will work closely with the team’s Staff Engineer and Team Lead, and help the broader organization understand how identity works at Circle.


What you will do

  • Own the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Circle’s identity and access platform. 
  • Manage, coach, and grow a team of backend and frontend engineers. Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, develop senior engineers into technical leaders, and hire well.
  • Stay close to the code and systems. Lead technical designs, review critical code paths, debug production issues with the team, participate in incident response, and build prototypes when that is the fastest way to make progress.
  • Partner with Security, Product, Onboarding, Risk, and product engineering teams that integrate with identity. 
  • Turn competing requests into a sequenced roadmap and explain the trade-offs behind it.
  • Run the team’s delivery process, including planning, scoping, migrations, cutovers, rollback plans, and honest status reporting.
  • Improve the team’s engineering practices, operational readiness, and ability to provide reliable platform capabilities to the rest of Circle.

What we are looking for

  • Experienced manager. You have at least three years of experience managing software engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and developing senior individual contributors. You have led a team through a significant migration, re-platforming, or architectural change.
  • Deep identity or authorization experience. You have substantial hands-on experience building identity, authentication, authorization, or access-control systems at scale. Your background may include OAuth 2.x and OIDC, SAML and enterprise SSO, session and token design, API credentials, service or workload identity, MFA and passkeys, or policy and entitlement engines.
  • Strong architectural judgment. You have designed a system that other teams built on. You can explain the important trade-offs, how you managed migration and adoption, and what you would change if you were designing it again today.
  • Still technical. You stay close to production systems, read code and designs critically, and can help debug a difficult authentication or authorization issue. Recently, you have designed, prototyped, reviewed, or shipped production code.

Especially valuable for this role

  • Experience with AI agent identity, delegated authorization, workload identity, service identity, or other non-human identity systems.

  • Experience building or operating systems where software agents or automated services can take consequential actions under bounded authority.

We do not expect this area to have a settled playbook. We do expect you to be comfortable designing secure systems in an emerging space and to understand the difference between an agent’s identity, the authority delegated to it, and the credentials it uses at runtime.
